notes_for_editor: Two lookout-specific sources, which agree the site is gone. The 1934 date and the 1940s abandonment come from firelookout.com alone. The landmark-names PDF gives only the name origin and does not link Foster Stanley to the lookout. Not on the NHLR Montana list; FFLOS was not checked. No staffing, fire or current-site source was found, so the story is short.
